text: A Psalm of David. 1 O YHWH, who may sojourn in Your tent? Who may dwell in the mountain of Your Holiness?
The one walking blamelessly, and doing righteousness, and speaking truth in his heart.
He does not have slander upon his tongue, and he has not done evil to his neighbor, and a reproach he has not taken up against his neighbor.
A rejected one is despised in his eyes, and those fearful of YHWH he honors—one [who] swears to endure evil, and not changing.
His silver he has not given in usury, and he does not take a bribe against the innocent. The one doing these [things] is not shaken forever.
